title: Provider evidence and evaluation binding must share machine-verifiable provenance identities
decision: BOUND_UNOPENED binding must reference provider evidence_id and license_evidence_sha256
provider evidence raw_sha256, normalized_dataset_id and code_sha must equal binding dataset identities
every binding market-data boundary marked verified must carry supporting evidence SHA-256
rationale: Provider evidence and evaluation binding were independently strict but not machine-linked, allowing a later binding to switch data/code identities or upgrade boundaries with free text unless reviewers manually noticed.
migration: No real binding exists and frozen holdout is unopened, so the bridge is added before first real binding without rewriting real evidence.
